grammarOverview.title: Grammar & Accuracy Overview
grammarOverview.summary: The portfolio separates content exposure from independent mastery and keeps the current grammar work tied to school tasks.
focusPoints: Present Simple: practiced in July for statements, negatives, questions and frequency; current retention has not been reassessed.
Can / can't: practiced in August for ability and permission; verify student-authored sentences with the base verb.
Should / shouldn't: practiced in July and August for advice; verify modal choice and base-verb construction without a model.
